<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0112-30-39" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:mtshan_nyid">dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4207">me dig pa</rs> na de <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> dam mar 'gro ba la skyod 2 dang
            bral dgos pa'i phyis dang | skyon 2 gang dang ma bral yang <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> du mar mi 'gro ba'i
            phyir skyon 2 du grangs ngos || deg byang ma khyab pa dang khyab ches pa kun dus te mi
            srid pa'ang mchod bya pa ma khyab pa yod || | byas pa'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> du mi rtag pa bkod pas
            dang du yang dngos po mi srid pa ma yin mod kyi | nyid du mi srid pa yin pas mi srid par
            'du bas || <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="31b5"/> de dag kyang mtshon bya la ltos nas nga skyon du che la |
            mtshan gzhi' la ltos nas ni mi srid pa dang ma khyab pa 2 spyod du che'i shes zer te
            dpyad par byas ||</seg></TEI>
